name: Voltaic Cyclosword

passives.name: Energized
passives.effects: Moving and basic attacking generates Energize stacks, up to 100.

passives.name: Galvanize
passives.effects: Damaging an enemy champion with an ability triggers the effects of Energized attacks against them if they are ready.

passives.name: Firmament
passives.effects: When fully Energized, your next basic attack on-hit grants you (15 /12) lethality for 4 seconds before dealing bonus physical damage equal to (9% /7%) of the target's current health, capped at 200 against non-champions.
